//: Extra permissions for this project. scripts/merge-permissions.sh adds them to every profile in <flow dir>/.claude/*-permissions.json each time claude starts. Allow the commands in config.mk (tests, formatting) here. make check rejects commands that must never be allowed (general-purpose readers like cat / grep, bare interpreters, git -C, ...); see docs/setup.md. Every .env is already denied by the base profiles; to protect other secret files, add them to deny as Read(//**/<path>), e.g. "deny": ["Read(//**/config/secrets.yml)"] (a relative path would only match under the flow directory). This project has no formatter. Single test files run through npm run test:<name> (see package.json), not bare node. Each test:<name> is listed explicitly: a rule like "npm run test:*" matches "npm run test ..." only (the word before :* must end at a space), not "npm run test:rules". Add an entry here when a test:<name> script is added.
